title: Entry speed calculation
description: Essential: Student must correctly compute the speed at magnetic field entry as V = √2 V₀ using velocity decomposition at point Q.

title: Electric field magnitude
description: Essential: Student must derive E = m V₀²/(2qL) from work-energy theorem applied to motion in the electric field.

title: Magnetic field magnitude
description: Essential: Student must derive B = 2m V₀/(qL) using Lorentz force and circular motion geometry in the magnetic field.

title: Total time O to P
description: Essential: Student must compute total time as t = (8+π)L/(4V₀) by summing magnetic and electric field transit times.

title: Circular motion geometry
description: Important: Student must correctly relate the arc OQ to the radius using the 90° central angle and 45° injection angle.

title: Work-energy application
description: Important: Student must properly apply work-energy theorem with correct sign for electric potential energy change.

title: Velocity decomposition at Q
description: Important: Student must resolve velocity components at point Q to connect V₀ with the entry speed V.

title: Kinematics in electric field
description: Optional: Student may analyze vertical and horizontal motions separately using constant acceleration equations.

title: Sign error in work-energy
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly assigns sign to work done by electric field, leading to wrong E expression.

title: Geometry misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Student misidentifies the central angle or radius relationship, affecting B and time calculations.
